item.title: Patient perspectives of participation in clinical studies in late-onset Pompe disease: Structured exit interviews from cipaglucosidase alfa plus miglustat studies
item.description: This study presents structured exit interview data from patients with late-onset Pompe disease who participated in clinical trials evaluating cipaglucosidase alfa combined with miglustat.
